title: ArcadiaBench crew
description: A crew for the fleet design track (--crew FILE, or crew= in Python): how many robots of each of the catalog's four designs. Two rules are checked beyond this schema: a crew has 4 to 20 robots in all, and it weighs no more than the catalog's mass budget (docs/simulator.md, the fleet design track).

scout.description: Scouts: survey and verify the pad, and repair robots in the field.

excavator.description: Excavators: dig, grade and carry regolith.

hauler.description: Haulers: move regolith in bulk, recharge robots from a tank, and relay comms.

compactor_sinterer.description: Compactor-sinterers: compact the graded surface, then sinter it.
